data.objective: You are a shopper who wants to buy one item. Read the free-shipping promise in the banner at the top of the page and remember it as shipping_promise. Choose the most expensive product, select an option if one is required, and add exactly one to the cart. Open the cart. Remember the item price shown in the cart as item_price, the subtotal as cart_subtotal and the shipping line as shipping_line. Click Checkout and check that a page asking for payment details appears. Do not type into any payment field and never pay.

data.summary:
The agent opened checkout and then asserted that payment details were visible without completing the required contact information and continuing to the payment step.
Update the run to enter valid contact information, select Continue to payment, wait for the Payment step, and only then verify that payment details are requested.
